name: kernel
summary: PureDarwin ARM64 VIRT kernel and headless kernel extensions built from the pinned PureDarwin next-branch snapshot with the reviewed CMake profile.

license.notes: sources.lock.json records 'Mixed; component license notices apply' for puredarwin-vm-next. Per-component notices govern; see docs/audits/puredarwin-reuse.md before redistribution.

isolation: Source checkout must match the locked revision and tree; patches apply only to a fresh isolated overlay. Compilation uses the recorded host toolchain against the host SDK; no host runtime is linked into the kernel.

rebuild.note: Recipe and pins are validated by scripts/build/packages.py. A clean-environment rebuild with artifact comparison against a recorded receipt (xnu.py result.json) is remaining work; compile evidence is not boot acceptance.
